ns2:section.sectionText: Through case studies, interactive projects, and hands-on activities students will learn the fundamentals of service learning and technical skills that will guide them in future project work. In this course students will have a virtual service-learning experience with partners in Bolivia working on real projects. The course concludes with a service trip to Bolivia between January 4 -13 of 2023. Enrollment in this section does not include travel costs, which must be paid separately. Estimated travel costs are $3574 and include round-trip airfare, ground transportation, lodging, meals, international insurance, and in-country programming. Scholarships are available.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
